competitions.name: BWF Arctic Open (Super 500)
competitions.status: Live · SFs 10 Oct, final 11 Oct · Indians out
competitions.note: 20-member Indian squad led by PV Sindhu. Round-of-32 draws: Prannoy v Anders Antonsen (4), Srikanth v Brian Yang, Tanvi Sharma v Chiu Pin-Chian, Isharani Baruah v Ratchanok Intanon (1), Ashmita Chaliha v Line Christophersen (7), Unnati Hooda v Han Qian Xi. Qualifying (6 Oct): Malvika Bansod, Rounak Chouhan and Tharun Mannepalli won their qualifiers in three games. PV Sindhu beat Wen Yu Zhang (CAN) 21-8 21-11 in her opener; Tanvi Sharma upset world No. 18 Chiu Pin-Chian 21-15 21-17 to reach the pre-quarter-finals; Unnati Hooda (16-21 21-15 22-24 v Han Qian Xi), Ashmita Chaliha (7-21 21-14 24-26 v Line Christophersen) and Malvika Bansod (18-21 13-21 v Kirsty Gilmour) are out. Wed 7 Oct round of 32: HS Prannoy lost 10-21 9-21 to Anders Antonsen (4) and Isharani Baruah lost 10-21 15-21 to Ratchanok Intanon (1); Krishna Prasad Garaga/Pruthvi Krishnamurthy Roy upset fifth seeds He Jiting/Ren Xiangyu 10-21 21-18 22-20 in men's doubles. Also out in the round of 32: Tharun Mannepalli (16-21 14-21 v Magnus Johannesen) and Rounak Chouhan (20-22 22-20 17-21 v Weng Hongyang). Kidambi Srikanth v Brian Yang (~22:45 IST) result not yet found. Garaga/Roy next face England's Oliver Butler/Samuel Jones. PV Sindhu plays Riko Gunji in the pre-quarter-finals; Tanvi Sharma is also in the last 16. Watch: FanCode and BWF TV on YouTube (no confirmed TV broadcast in India). QFs 9 Oct, SFs 10 Oct, final 11 Oct. Followed by the Denmark Open (Super 750) from 13 Oct. Thu 8 Oct last 16: Sindhu v Riko Gunji, Tanvi Sharma v Ratchanok Intanon (1), Garaga/Roy v Butler/Jones (not before 21:40 IST). Srikanth does not appear on the day's order of play (Brian Yang is listed in the last 16), so he is out. Thu 8 Oct last 16: PV Sindhu beat Riko Gunji 21-15 21-15 to reach the QFs (reported opponent: Intanon); Tanvi Sharma lost 18-21 7-21 to Intanon; Tharun Mannepalli lost 14-21 19-21 to Christo Popov (2). Garaga/Roy v Butler/Jones result awaited. Update: all Indians are out after Garaga/Roy lost the men's doubles QF 13-21, 14-21 to Kjær/Kjær.
